title: Evaluate the Y-jets of a line power on its vanishing line
statement: For natural numbers n,r with r≤n and any t∈ℂ, let D_Y denote formal differentiation in variable 1. The evaluation of D_Y^r(linePow n t) at (1,−t) equals n! when r=n and equals zero otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (n r : ℕ), r ≤ n → ∀ t : ℂ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] (HeckeEis.linePow n t).val) = (if r = n then (Nat.factorial n : ℂ) else 0)
